sloka: रामस्य पुरुषव्याघ्रः सहायः समरे अरिहा ।स भ्राता लक्ष्मणो नाम धर्म चारी दृढ व्रतः ॥३-४७-१९॥
transliteration: rāmasya puruṣavyāghraḥ sahāyaḥ samare arihā ।sa bhrātā lakṣmaṇo nāma dharma cārī dṛḍha vrataḥ ॥3-47-19॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, his brother, is righteous and steadfast. Bow in hand, he followed Rama along with me, into exile.
